scope: Phase 1 + Phase 2: all screens in the design prompt sections 7.1 to 7.11, component sheet, frames gallery, design notes

philosophy.notes: Dense developer-tool posture held across every screen, including onboarding and spec pages. No marketing patterns.

hierarchy.notes: Waiting for you is the single strongest signal everywhere it appears: filled chip, pinned sidebar group, title-bar tally, unread bell chip, tray dot.

execution.notes: All 43 frames render without JS errors in a headless DOM and the onboarding flow passes an automated click-through. Not yet reviewed visually: spacing, overflow, and the 960 layout still need a human look.

specificity.notes: Copy, states, error reasons, and flags come from the prompt and the Lark domain; no invented metrics. Notification grouping and tray quit rules accepted 2026-10-19.

restraint.notes: Amber primary limited to one action per view and the focus ring. One flourish: the attention pulse, 3 cycles only, off under reduced motion.

open: Visual review of frames.html (Both x Both)
